subject: Private deployment packaging & pricing — initial terms for Medixa
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Kelly Rogers <kelly@medixa.com>, procurement@medixa.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment packaging & pricing — initial terms for Medixa

Hi Kelly / Medixa procurement team,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday — excited about the chance to partner. Per our call, below is a concise set of commercial terms for a Private deployment (VPC / on-prem) to support your regulated workloads. I'm attaching a short pricing sheet and a draft SOW for the initial rollout.

High-level commercial options (annual):
- Platform fee (control plane & managed services): $75,000 / year
- Private deployment license (per active production node): $30,000 / node / year
- Support tiers:
  - Standard (business hours, standard SLAs) — included
  - Premium (24/7, 4-hour response, annual architecture review) — +20% of platform fee
- One-time onboarding & install: $15,000 (includes runbook handover & 2 onsite days)

Flexible terms and volume incentives:
- 3-year commit: 10% off platform fee (applies to all years)
- 5+ nodes: we can discuss volume-based license pricing
- Data residency & add-ons priced separately (audit log retention, long-term backups)

Requested next steps from Medixa:
1) Confirm expected number of production nodes (you mentioned ~6 in the call).
2) Indicate preferred support tier (Standard or Premium).
3) Confirm timeline (target go-live / procurement windows).

Attachments: Redwood_Private_Pricing_Sheet_v2.pdf, SOW_Draft_Medixa.docx

Happy to jump on a short call if you want to walk through the line items.

Best,
Rishi

From: Kelly Rogers <kelly@medixa.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medixa.com, Gareth Li <gareth.legal@medixa.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment packaging & pricing — initial terms for Medixa

Rishi — thanks for the quick summary. A few follow-ups from procurement and our finance sponsor: 

1) Node count: We expect 6 production nodes at launch (NY + SF + EU DR footprint). We may scale after Q4.
2) Platform fee: Given this is a multi-year, multi-region private deployment and we have an existing relationship with your public API team, procurement is asking if you can significantly discount the platform fee (example asks: 30% off in year 1 or waiver of year 1 platform fee).
3) Support: We need Premium support included for the first year (critical for our compliance team).
4) License transfer / audit: Can licenses be transferred to an acquiring entity if Medixa is ever acquired? We also need SOC 2 audit artifacts and a 7-year logging retention option.

Goal: Procurement wants a clean pay-and-signable commercial sheet we can send to legal by end of March. Can you come back with an adjusted price cadence that reflects the scale & long-term commitment?

Thanks,
Kelly Rogers
Head of Platform Operations
Medixa Health
kelly@medixa.com | +1 212-555-0199

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Medixa — platform fee push from procurement (need pricing approval)

Marissa / Neha — forwarding Kelly's reply. Procurement is pushing hard on platform fee (asking for up to 30% off or waiver year 1) and insisting Premium support be included. They expect a signable sheet by EOM.

Quick context: 6 prod nodes, multi-region DR (NY/SF/EU) — likely to be a reference account if we land it. Their finance wants amortization flexibility for platform fee across regions; legal will push on license transfer language.

Can we approve any of the following concessions without eroding our go-to-market? My initial asks: 1) discount up to 15% on platform fee for a 3-year commit; 2) waive onboarding fee for year-1; 3) reduce per-node license to $28k if they commit to 3-year term and 6 nodes.

If we can do that, I can close the commercial quickly. If not, we should counter with staged discounts. 

Thoughts?
Rishi

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Medixa — platform fee push from procurement (need pricing approval)

Rishi — thanks for flagging. Medixa looks strategically useful (healthcare reference + likely to expand). Approve the following limited concessions to enable a clean signature by March 31: 

1) Platform fee: up to 15% discount off the listed $75k / year for a 3-year committed term. Discount applies to all three years and requires execution by 2026-03-31.
2) Onboarding fee: waive the $15k one-time onboarding if they sign the 3-year commitment by the date above.
3) Per-node license: reduce to $28k / node / year (from $30k) for the initial 6 nodes when they commit to 3 years. If nodes grow past 8, we will revisit a new volume tier.
4) Support: include Premium support for year 1 as a concession; price Premium at 15% of platform fee (reduced from standard 20%) for years 2+ (unless they pay up front for multi-year support).
5) Compliance add-ons: offer audit-log retention add-on at $5k / year; provide SOC 2 artifacts and a one-time package for security review (legal to confirm exact scope).

Conditions / guardrails:
- All concessions contingent on a standard 3-year MSA with a limited discount schedule and no bespoke revenue share commitments.
- Require a minimum commitment of 4 production nodes. If they drop below 4 after year 1, we reserve right to reprice.
- Finance needs to confirm the margin impact; Neha, can you run a quick margin check and mark any items that require uplift?

If margins look acceptable, Rishi — go back to Kelly with a firm commercial and the two attachments you already have. Loop legal for a fast review of license transfer language; do not promise transfer without legal sign-off.

Marissa
VP, Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Kelly Rogers <kelly@medixa.com>, procurement@medixa.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment packaging & pricing — Medixa counteroffer

Kelly — thanks for the transparency and the procurement ask. We had an internal review and can offer the following final commercial to meet your timeline. This is intended to be signable for your legal/procurement team.

Final commercial (requires 3-year MSA executed by 2026-03-31):
- Platform fee: $75,000 / year with a 15% discount applied to each year (effective net $63,750 / year)
- Private deployment license: $28,000 / node / year for the initial 6 production nodes (NY/SF/EU).
- Support: Premium support included for Year 1. Premium priced at 15% of platform fee for Years 2-3 unless prepaid for multiple years.
- Onboarding: Waived (no one-time onboarding fee) if signed by 2026-03-31.
- Compliance add-ons: Audit-log retention add-on available at $5,000 / year; SOC 2 artifacts and a security package will be provided as part of the SOW.
- License transfer: We can include a standard change-of-control clause; any license assignment to a third party requires Redwood approval and may require a short commercial adjustment — legal will propose exact language.

Next steps:
1) If the above is acceptable, reply to this thread and we'll issue an updated pricing sheet and MSA + SOW for legal review.
2) DocuSign link will be prepared and sent once legal confirms the MSA draft (see HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/7421).
3) Target go/no-go: sign by 2026-03-31 to lock the concessions.

Attachments: Redwood_Private_Pricing_Sheet_v2.pdf, SOW_Draft_Medixa.docx
